query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
diagnoses as "Diagnoses",
referral_type as "Referral name",
referring_doctor_name as "Referring doctor",
to_char(((referral_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Referral date",
department as "Department"
from "reporting"."ds__referrals"
where status in ('pending', 'cancelled')
and ((referral_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
>= 
:fromDate
and
((referral_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
<= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:doctorId is null then true
else referring_doctor_id = 
:doctorId
end
and
case
when 
:villageId is null then true
else village_id = 
:villageId
end
order by referral_datetime, last_name, first_name
name: Incomplete referrals
notes: This report lists all patients that have a pending referral for the selected parameters.
